example.content:
const ok = await eda.sys_ShortcutKey.unregisterShortcutKey(['F9', 'ALT', 'CONTROL']);
console.log('反注册返回：', ok);

_source.title: 反注册快捷键
_source.example.text.0: 1. 先注册一个演示快捷键作为操作对象
_source.example.text.1: 2. 反注册：故意打乱键序传入，验证不区分排列顺序的匹配规则
_source.example.text.2: 3. 复查快捷键列表，确认演示键位已被移除
_source.params.shortcutKey: 快捷键，不区分传入的排列顺序，将自动排序并查询匹配的快捷键

title: Unregister a shortcut key
params.shortcutKey: Shortcut key. The order of the passed-in elements is not distinguished; it will be sorted automatically and the matching shortcut key will be queried
returns: Whether the unregistration operation was successful
